stem: Why would a clinician choose to use DTPA instead of MAG 3 for a functional scan?

options.text: To perform a formal GFR scan in addition to looking for obstruction.
Because the patient is a very young infant.
To identify areas of cortical scarring.

explanation: DTPA has the unique advantage of allowing for a formal measurement of the glomerular filtration rate during the assessment of obstruction.
rationale: Consider the specific physiological measurement that DTPA can provide beyond simple visualization.

optionExplanations.A: DTPA has the unique advantage of allowing for a formal measurement of the glomerular filtration rate during the assessment of obstruction.
optionExplanations.B: MAG 3 is actually the more common tracer used for younger children.
optionExplanations.C: Both MAG 3 and DTPA are nuclear medicine scans that require intravenous tracer injection.
optionExplanations.D: Cortical scarring is identified by a DMSA scan, not DTPA or MAG 3.
